For $m$ odd: $= i^m t^m\left(\frac{1}{(1+it)^\nu} + \frac{1}{(1-it)^\nu}\right) = i^m t^m \cdot 2\,\text{Re}((1+it)^{-\nu})$. This gives Re!

So for $m$ odd, the Abel-Plana formula gives us an integral involving $\text{Re}((1+it)^{-\nu})$.
